page.layout: One page of text: a verse poem at the top, followed by a printer's signature "A. F." at the right; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page; the gathering signature at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Præsens auxilio, consilio fauens Regum sceptra tenens Rex Deus annuat Sic tandem domitis hostibus exeras Dignum rege caput: quo tremat igneis Quicquid sol radÿs[?] recreat aureus: Sic tecum(auspice quo fregeris hostium Cervicem )venerans orbis amet Deum.

page.notes: The central woodcut is a circular floral ornament (scrollwork with leaves and dots), not text. The running head reads "GVISIAC A." with a dot after the A; the final letter may be a damaged A, so it is not marked. "radÿs" is printed with a y-form and is marked as doubtful. The printed parenthesis after "tecum" and before "Cervicem" is copied as printed. Show-through from the reverse side appears faintly in the margins and was left out.
